name: HHat
description:
TR-909 hi-hat PCM circuit model on a phrase pad. Hold to run. X = Euclidean step density, Y = Close → Open continuum (CH/OH ROM windows + decay).
Still being fine-tuned; the official release is coming soon.

params.name: DENS
params.detail: Euclidean hits per 16-step bar (1–16), then 32nd rolls

params.name: OPEN
params.detail: Close (bottom) → Open (top). Crossfades CH/OH ROM windows and morphs analog decay; closing chokes

params.name: TUNE
params.detail: ROM clock rate (±7 st around 30 kHz; hardware hats had no Tune)

params.name: DEC
params.detail: Master decay scale for the Close–Open range
